name: overflow-list
title: Overflow List
description: Chip list or avatar stack that collapses to "+N more" but always keeps failed items, the signed-in user and pinned items visible, and spells out what the expand button hides ("+4 more, 1 skipped") instead of a bare count.

meta.summary: A "+3 more" chip list or avatar stack that always keeps failed items, you and pinned items visible, and says what the overflow hides.
catches: Failed or error items hidden behind "+N more"
The signed-in user folded into the overflow
Bare counts that hide what kind of items are folded
limits: max is a count, not measured width
Warning items can still fold; only errors are always kept
a11y: Labelled list; each item's text includes its status
Status is shown by icon and text, not colour alone
Avatar images have empty alt with the name in text; initials are aria-hidden
